target_claim: The stated subset P has a smallest element merely because the ambient set is well-ordered.
source_quote:
Consider the [[Definition:Subset|subset]] of $\powerset \N$:

:$P \subseteq \set {a \in \powerset \N : \powerset \N_a \text{ is uncountable} }$

Then $P$ has a [[Definition:Smallest Element|smallest element]], by the definition of a [[Definition:Well-Ordered Set|well-ordered set]].
